decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2906/104 received 03/11/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The use of the ancillary restaurant (shaded red on plan 2906/104) shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 0700-2300 Monday-Friday; 0700-0000 Saturdays; 0900-2200 Sundays.
Condition : 3 - The use of the main retail floorspace (shaded grey on plan 2906/104) shall not be open before 8am nor after 9pm Monday to Saturday.
Condition : 4 - The petrol filling station shall only be open to customers between the hours of 7.30am to 9.30pm Monday to Thursday and Saturday, 7am to 10pm Friday and 9am to 4.30pm on Sunday.

Condition : 5 - That no physical internal portioning of the restaurant or equivalent works to separate it from the superstore shall occur without the prior grant of planning permission from the local planning authority. Furthermore, the existing internal link between the superstore and the restaurant  shall be retained unobstructed for use by customers at all times the superstore and restaurant are both open.

Condition : 6 - No storage activity in connection with the retail use shall be carried on outside the retail building hereby permitted without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The site to be used for the purpose of a Petrol Filling Station shall be used for that purpose only and no vehicle repairs or any other industrial process shall be carried out on the premises, nor shall there be the display of cars for sale.
Condition : 8 - The retail store shall at no time contain a durable goods sales area exceeding 5,000 sq ft unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - The retail store shall be closed from 11am until 6pm or from two hours before kick-off and not re-open until two hours after the scheduled finish, whichever is the soonest, in consultation with the Metropolitan Policy and Rugby Football Union, on days when Rugby Football matches are held at the Twickenham ground where the crowd, based on previous attendances for such fixtures, is reasonably anticipated to be in excess of 30,000 persons. A maximum of 10 days in any one year may be so allocated, provided that the Local Planning Authority shall serve notice of the dates of closure 12 months in advance of the aforesaid matches.
description: Application for variation of condition X1(b) of planning permission 00768/J/P2 to allow restaurant within store to open from 7am to 11pm Monday to Friday, 7am to midnight on Saturday and 9 am to 10pm on Sundays.
